name: seekone
description: SeekOne microwell-based single-cell RNA-seq. Public FASTQs may require SeekOne-specific barcode/linker extraction, whitelist correction, and preprocessing before STAR-based mapping.
notes: UniScFlow downloads and records platform inference for SeekOne datasets, but stops before automatic read assignment and mapping.
Use vendor documentation or a validated SeekOne preprocessing workflow to extract barcode/UMI information before downstream alignment.

halt_guidance.blocker: SeekOne processing depends on product-specific barcode/linker rules and whitelists, which vary between 3-prime, 5-prime, and full-length products.
required_inputs: Exact SeekOne product/kit version and matching barcode configuration
SeekSoul Tools module/configuration and compatible reference
next_steps: Confirm whether the dataset is SeekOne 3-prime, 5-prime, or full-length RNA and exclude companion VDJ or multiome libraries.
Select the matching SeekSoul Tools module and barcode configuration.
Run SeekSoul Tools and preserve its configuration and validated matrix output.

recommended_workflows.name: SeekSoul Tools
recommended_workflows.role: SeekOne barcode extraction, alignment, and quantification

halt_guidance.resume: Use the validated SeekSoul Tools matrix downstream; UniScFlow does not infer proprietary product-specific barcode resources.
